description: Time-averages AND traces the spectrum in one pass: blurring smears the spectrum over N analysis windows (as blur blur) while tracing keeps only the loudest N channels per window (as hilite trace) - the classic blur+trace composite with both parameters time-variable. Ranges are input-dependent and CDP-enforced: blurring 1 to the window count ('(1.000000 to 698.000000)' quoted on a 698-window analysis), tracing 1 to the channel count ('(1.000000 to 513.000000)' on a 1024-point analysis). Both breakpoint-capable (each ramp differs from both scalar-endpoint renders; banner-confirmed 'blurring AND tracing may vary over time'). Static duration (2.0230 / 1.5209); deterministic. Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: The one-call 'ghost' maker: trace thins the sound to its dominant components and blur melts what survives into a slow wash - the canonical recipe for turning any source into a spectral shadow of itself (the separate blur blur -> hilite trace chain, fused, and cheaper than two passes). Both controls riding breakpoints makes trajectories the point: dissolve a full sound into a 6-channel smear (blurring up, tracing down), or crystallise a haze back into focus (both down). Sizing intuition carries over from the parents: tracing has to fall surprisingly low (below ~20) before the result turns properly skeletal, and blurring needs internal change to bite - near-static sources barely alter.

blurring.description: Number of analysis windows over which the spectrum is averaged. CDP-enforced 1 to the input's window count ('0'/'100000' refused verbatim quoting '(1.000000 to 698.000000)' - input-dependent ceiling). May vary over time via breakpoint file (verified: a 1-to-50 ramp differs from both endpoints).

tracing.description: Number of loudest channels retained per window. CDP-enforced 1 to the analysis channel count ('0'/'40000' refused verbatim quoting '(1.000000 to 513.000000)'). May vary over time via breakpoint file (verified: a 2-to-100 ramp differs from both endpoints).

examples.description: Ghost wash: strong smear, few surviving channels.
examples.expected_use: Dominant components only, melted across ~87 ms of windows - a spectral shadow of the source.

examples.description: Dissolve into haze across the file.
examples.expected_use: Starts nearly intact, ends as a 6-channel smear.

known_issues: Both ranges are input-dependent (window count / channel count) and quoted in the refusals; the JSON leaves the maxima null.
Aggressive tracing collapses spectrally simple sources toward silence quickly (hilite trace family behavior) - gain-stage after resynthesis.
